ModMetaData.name: Deathrest Unbound
ModMetaData.author: Xmaxer
ModMetaData.description:
Removes the deathrest building cap and uses power as the limit instead.
- A deathresting pawn uses every deathrest building in the room. This works for every xenotype with the deathrest gene. - While someone deathrests in it, a casket draws its base power x 1.5^n, where n is the number of buildings it uses. Eight buildings cost about 2.6 kW and twelve about 13 kW. - Deathrest buildings link to every casket in their room and can serve several deathresting pawns at once. A building draws its power and burns its hemogen once per casket it serves. - A new "Deathrest" tab on caskets and deathrest buildings lets you switch links off, shows what each one costs, and jumps between them. - Traders and loot no longer offer the deathrest capacity serum. Serum you already have still works.
You can configure capacity, per-building stack limits, the power exponent, building power and fuel scaling, and the serum in the mod settings.
Works with modded deathrest buildings and caskets. Also supports Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage.
Safe to add to an existing save. Buildings already bound to a pawn become casket links when the save loads.
Requires Harmony and Biotech.
